questions.quote: Read the angle shown, and subtract from 90° to find your angle of vision from your eye to the top of the tree

en.q: A clinometer reads 55° when sighting the top of a tree. What is the angle of vision to the top of the tree?
en.explanation: The angle of vision is found by subtracting the clinometer reading from 90 degrees: 90 - 55 = 35 degrees.

ta.explanation: சாய்வுமானி அளவை 90°இலிருந்து கழிக்க பார்வைக் கோணம் கிடைக்கும்: 90 - 55 = 35°.
